'''Bavin Rockshaw''' works as [[Perrin Aybara]]'s quartermaster. He is from [[Cairhien]].

== Appearance ==
He is pale-faced, with blond speckled in his gray hair. He is quite slender but with a pot-gut.

== History ==
He has worked as a quartermaster since the [[Aiel War]].

== Activities ==
He helps distribute food to all the refugees traveling with Perrin after the [[Battle of Malden]].

[[Faile]] confronts him on some of his corrupt dealings within the camp and sends him a warning to cut it out.
